sql:
```sql
SELECT 
    f.[FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)]
FROM 
    frpm f
JOIN 
    satscores s ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE 
    s.rtype = 'Reading'
GROUP BY 
    f.[School Name]
ORDER BY 
    AVG(s.AvgScrRead) DESC
LIMIT 1;
```
